model_annotation: This plot illustrates the change in loss over the course of iterations for different models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 140,000 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", has a linear scale with a value range of 2.4 to 3.4 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot: the purple line represents "Vanilla" with a solid line style and no markers; the blue line represents "StrmLLM (n=64)" with a solid line style and no markers; the orange line represents "SepLLM (n=64)" with a solid line style and no markers; the green line represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)" with a solid line style and no markers; the red line represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" with a solid line style and no markers; and the dark blue line represents "SepLLM (n=128)" with a solid line style and no markers. The purple line starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.65, steadily decreasing with some noise; the blue line starts at approximately 3.25 and ends at approximately 2.65, steadily decreasing with some noise; the orange line starts at approximately 3.2 and ends at approximately 2.6, steadily decreasing with some noise; the green line starts at approximately 3.15 and ends at approximately 2.6, steadily decreasing with some noise; the red line starts at approximately 3.15 and ends at approximately 2.6, steadily decreasing with some noise; and the dark blue line starts at approximately 3.1 and ends at approximately 2.55, steadily decreasing with some noise.
